verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              प्रह्लादस्य च तच्छ्रत्वा हिरण्यकशिपुर्वचः। उवाच दानवान्त्सर्वोन्त्सगणांश्च गणाधिपः॥१॥
verses.english: The demon श्वेत, the son of विप्रचित्ति, wearing white ear-hangings, stood in the van of war reminding a white mountain...

verses.sanskrit: मृगेन्द्रो गृह्यतां शीघ्रमपूर्वां तनुमास्थितः। यदि वा संशयः काश्चद्वध्यतां वनगोचरः॥२॥
verses.english: He whose ample chest sparkles like the twinkles of moonbeams, because the brilliant gems so far stuck on the hoods of serpents are now stuck in the feathers of chest when he stuck them with his beak – hence, no more chest ornaments are called for...

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा दानवाः सर्वे मृगेन्द्रं भीमविक्रमम्। परिक्षिपन्तो मुदितास्त्रासयामासुरोजसा॥३॥
verses.english: His raiment is whitely white, bicep-lets coral, body sapphirine, and his belly is bearing the burden of pendants dangling on it – his belly is loaded with pearls, corals, sapphires, conches etc – so to speak...

verses.sanskrit: सिंहनादं नदित्वा तु पुनः सिंहो महाबलः। बभञ्ज तां सभां रम्यां व्यादितास्य इवान्तकः॥४॥
verses.english: And the mountains carting precipices and trees that are with numerous boughs have come and stood at the defensive end of gods, ready to sling their own assaults and batteries...

verses.sanskrit: सभायां भज्यमानायां हिरण्यकशिपुः स्वयम्। चिक्षेपास्त्राणि सिंहस्य रोषव्याकुललोचनः॥५॥
verses.english: Lordly serpants spreading on the sky with mouths agape looked like just darted darts of gods and they rancorously spewed venom on demons...

verses.sanskrit: सर्वास्त्राणामथ श्रेष्ठं दण्डमस्त्रं सुभैरवम्। कालचक्रं तथाऽत्युग्रं विष्णुचक्रं तथैव च॥६॥
verses.english: While the evanescent streaks of lightning sprinting from his weapon Thunderbolt formed into a protective electric reticulation around him; while he is enswathed in a host of black-clouds and all are moving together like the flying-mountains...

verses.sanskrit: धर्मचक्रं महच्चक्रमजितं नाम नामतः। चक्रमैन्द्रं तथा धोरमृषिचक्रं तथैव च॥७॥
verses.english: While that god indra started riding on elephant the Vedic scholars conducting soma rituals at that time started to sing vedic chants suffixed with स्वाहा wording... while the celestials sounded bugles and thousands of apsara dancers performed the auspicious promenading before him...

verses.sanskrit: पैतामहं तथा चक्रं त्रैलोक्यमाहितस्वनम्। विचित्रमशनीं चैव शुष्कार्द्रं चाशनिद्वयम्॥८॥
verses.english: He, who has primordial-waters as his provenance, eliminator of demon मधु, receiver of oblational offertories; one who is hallowed through Vedic rituals – यज्ञ पुरुष; who is identical with earth, water and ether, who is at one with all the five-elements – पन्चभूत-आत्म; endower of peace and equanimity of mind, and the destroys enemies...

verses.sanskrit: रौद्रं तदुग्रं शूलं च कङ्कालं मुसलं तथा। अस्त्रं ब्रह्माशिरश्चैव ब्राह्ममस्त्रं तथैव च॥९॥
verses.english: While the ensign of इन्द्र fluttered high on the chariot, which is yoked with a thousand horses and which can cruise with the speed of mind or air, that chariot glistened forth like the sun, whereby that best chariot, which is kept ready on his left beside ऐरावत elephant on which he is presently riding, with its charioteer मातलि ready at the reins, appeared as if it is Mt. मेरु enveloped with the resplendence of the sun... With such and such entourage इन्द्र, the commander of gods, set out for the battle with demons...

verses.sanskrit: ऐषीकमस्त्रमैन्द्रं च आग्नेयं शैशिरं तथा। वायव्यं मथनं नाम कापालमथ किङ्करम्॥१०॥
verses.english: He, whose horses are silvern like moonbeams, and who sported in a thousand ways with white-horses and whitecaps, say waves and wavelets, fluttered by air-god; he is now brandishing his weapon called काल-पाश, a noose...

verses.sanskrit: तथा चाप्रतिमां शक्तिं क्रौञ्चमस्त्रं तथैव च। अस्त्रं हयशिरश्चैव सौम्यमस्त्रं तथैव च॥११॥
verses.english: Such as he is that वरुण, the god of waters, is now in the midst of gods’ army wielding a noose, appearing ready to infringe the norms of battle as with an ocean ever ready to sprit beyond the shoreline...

verses.sanskrit: पैशाचमस्त्रममितं सार्प्यमस्त्रं तथाऽद्भुतम्। मोहनं शोषणं चैव सन्तापनावलापने॥१२॥
verses.english: He who is shielded by four oceans, whom serpents lick caressingly, rather, serpents lick their lips over him, i.e., they take delight in him, because both are subterranean beings... and he who is adorned with bicep-lets of pure conch and pristine pearls, and who dons a body wholly aggregate of waters...

verses.sanskrit: जृम्मणं प्रापणं चैव त्वाष्ट्रं चैव सुदारुणम्। कालमुद्गरमक्षोभ्यं क्षोभणं तु महाबलम्॥१३॥
verses.english: Supported by the armies of यक्ष, राक्षस, and गुह्यका-स् there came god कुबेर, the lord of wealth-management, whose vehicle is humankind, who presides over treasures in the formation of conch shells and lotuses... this wealth-giving god being an air-fighter he is now in an aircraft called पुSपक-विमान, wielding a mace; this god being the dear friend of god शिव, now looked exactly like शिव himself, in all his eagerness to fight back demons...

verses.sanskrit: संवर्तन मोहनं च तथा मायाघरं परम्। गान्धर्वमस्त्रं दयितमसिरत्नं च नन्दकम्॥१४॥
verses.english: The four mighty regents of four quarters of universe protected the four sides of the celestial army, viz., thousand-eyed इन्द्र protecting the eastern wing; lord of ancestral manes, यम, protecting southern wing; lord of waters, वरुण, protecting western wing; human-rider कुबेर protecting northern wing, by keeping a vigilant watch over their respective quarters...

verses.sanskrit: प्रस्वापनं प्रमथनं वारुणं चास्त्रमुत्तमम्। अस्त्रं पाशुपतं चैव यस्याप्रतिहता गतिः॥१५॥
verses.english: The sungod, सूर्य, encharioted in a seven-steed skywalking chariot, blazing with his own effulgent sunrays that keep everything ablaze, gyred afore the gateway of heaven like a spinning fire ball – अलात चक्रम् – by scorching worlds unendingly; causing rapid dawns and dusks by cursorily spinning round the Mt. मेरु in an on-again-off-again manner, that twelve-souled daymaker moved among the hosts of gods glowing with his own refulgence and shedding thousands of his shafts...

verses.sanskrit: एतान्यस्त्राणि सर्वाणि हिरण्यकशिपुस्तदा। चिक्षेप नारसिंहस्य दीप्तस्याग्नेर्यथाहुतिः॥१६॥
verses.english: The moongod, सोम, the possessor of cool moonshine has come to battlefield now, encharioted on a chariot harnessed with white horses, delighting the world with his cool and damp beams... him, who is in a cluster of stars; endowed with cool beams; presiding deity of the brAhmaNa-s; whose body is marked by a shadow of the earth; a dispeller of the nocturnal darkness; a lord of all luminous bodies in the sky; pith of all essences; protector of all herbs; a repository of nectar; the first source of food to the world; a gentle one; with refreshing essence – and the दानवा-s saw such a सोम, the moon, hovering on the battlefield ready to hurl his mesmerising moonbeams with which the hotheads of दानवा-s can be cooled and the war eschewed...

verses.sanskrit: अस्त्रैः प्रज्वलितैः सिंहमावृणोदसुराधिपः। विवस्वान्घर्मसमये हिमवन्तमिवांशुभिः॥१७॥
verses.english: He who diversifying himself in fivefold, viz. प्राण, अपान, व्यान, उदान, समान airs, abides in every living being as its life-force; further, he who shoulders the responsibility to undergo sevenfold diversification in another context, namely आवाह, प्रवाह etc airs to sustain the three worlds consisting of mobile and sessile... of whom, they say, the controller of fire; an all pervading entity; whose provenance is in the seven musical notes with which notes alone singing is feasible... of whom, they say, the subtlest element, a bodiless entity, a spacewalker, transits impetuously and produced by the production of sound in space - शब्द तन्मात्र गतम्; आकाश जम्... such as he is that vital-air of everyone, namely वायु, airgod, self-energetically started to give cyclonic gusts – प्रतिलोम - along with waterspouts, whirlwinds, twisters, typhoon etc just to demoralise the दैत्या forces...

verses.sanskrit: स ह्यमर्षानिलोद्भूतो दैत्यानां सैन्यसागरः। क्षणेनाप्लावयत्सिंहं मैनाकमिव सागरः॥१८॥
verses.english: The मरुत्-s, wind-gods, in league with gods, gandharvA-s and vidyadharA-s, began to sport with their naked swords that looked like serpents just out of their snake-pits...

verses.sanskrit: प्रासैः पाशैस्तथा शूलैर्गदाभिर्मुसलैस्तथा। वज्रैरशनिकल्पैश्च शिलाभिश्च महाद्रुमैः॥१९॥
verses.english: Lordly serpants spreading on the sky with mouths agape looked like just darted darts of gods and they rancorously spewed venom on demons...

verses.sanskrit: मुद्गरैः कूटपाशैश्च शूलोलूखलपर्वतैः। शतघ्नीभिश्च दीप्ताभिर्दण्डैरपि सुदारुणैः॥२०॥
verses.english: Which bird is gigantic like Mt. मन्दर that was set free after the churning of the ocean for ambrosia; which bird has displayed his prowess hundreds of times in the encounters between the gods and demons...

verses.sanskrit: परिवार्य समन्तात्तु निघ्नन्नस्त्रैर्हरिं तदा। स्वल्पमप्यस्य न क्षुण्णमूर्जितस्य महात्मनः॥२१॥
verses.english: You have thus heard of the arrangement of the दैत्य array in the war between the gods and demons, O boy, now hear an account of the arrangement of army of gods which is nothing else than the army of विष्णु॥।

verses.sanskrit: ते दानवाः पाशगृहीतहस्ता महेन्द्रवज्राशनितुल्यवेगाः। समन्ततोऽभ्युद्यतबाहुशस्त्राः स्थितास्त्रिशीर्षा इव पन्नगेन्द्राः॥२२॥
verses.english: He, who has primordial-waters as his provenance, eliminator of demon मधु, receiver of oblational offertories; one who is hallowed through Vedic rituals – यज्ञ पुरुष; who is identical with earth, water and ether, who is at one with all the five-elements – पन्चभूत-आत्म; endower of peace and equanimity of mind, and the destroys enemies...

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णमालाकुलभूषिताङ्गा नानाङ्गदाभोगपिनद्धगात्राः। मुक्तावलीदामविभूषिताङ्गा हंसा इवाभान्ति विशालपक्षाः॥२३॥
verses.english: He, who is the source and seed of the universe, who is the preceptor of the world, magnanimous at heart - that श्रीहरि came up in the midst of the celestial army upcasting his unique refulgence prefatorily, which aureole looked like the fused flare of sun and fire, and that wielder of disc and mace, श्रीहरि, rose up like the sun blazing in his sphere, presently brandishing his mace – भ्रामयमाणायाः गदायाः – परिवेषस्य उपम - and spinning his enemy-eliminating disc...

verses.sanskrit: तेषां तु वायुप्रतिमौजसां वै केयूरमालावलयोत्कटानि। तान्युत्तमाङ्गान्यभितो विभान्ति प्रभातसूर्याशुसमप्रभाणि॥२४॥
verses.english: Wielding his massive mace called कौमोदकि in the lower right hand, which black-bodied mace is a devastator and the endower of end-time to enemies; and wielding many other weapons like his bow शारङ्ग etc with his other hands, that highly glorious श्रीहरि, whose flag is marked with the enemy of serpents, namely गरुड, appeared there...

verses.sanskrit: तैः प्रक्षिपद्भर्ज्वलितानलोपमैर्महास्त्रपूर्गः स समावृतो बभौ। गिरिर्यथा सन्ततवार्षिभिर्घनैः कृतान्धकारोद्भुतकन्दरद्रुमः॥२५॥
verses.english: He who is the son of sage काश्यप, a bird sustaining on serpents, a skywalker speedier than wind in his scoop and upsetting the skies, in whose beak a just caught mighty serpent will be squirming, at any given time...

verses.sanskrit: तैर्हन्यमानोऽपि महास्त्रजालैः सर्वैस्तदा दैत्यगणैः समेतैः। नाकम्पताजौ भगवान्प्रतापवान्स्थितः प्रकृत्या हिमवानिवाचलः॥२६॥
verses.english: Which bird is gigantic like Mt. मन्दर that was set free after the churning of the ocean for ambrosia; which bird has displayed his prowess hundreds of times in the encounters between the gods and demons...

verses.sanskrit: सन्तापितास्ते नरसिंहरूपिणा दितेः सुताः पावकदीप्ततेजसा। भयाद्विचेलुः पवनोद्धता यथा महोर्मयः सागरवारिसम्भवाः॥२७॥
verses.english: Whose body is marked with a mark of Thunderbolt when इन्द्र hurled at him while this bird is trying to embezzle ambrosia from heaven; which bird has plumery, diadem and shinning ear-hangings; whose raiment is his own wings; and who looks like a mountain impregnated with ores...

verses.sanskrit: शतैर्धनुर्भिः सुमहातिवेगा युगान्तकालप्रतिमाञ्छरौघान्। एकायनस्था मुमुचुर्नसिंहे महासुराः क्रोधविदीपिताङ्गाः॥२८॥
verses.english: And then, he who is highly illustrious हृषीकेश, with a lotus in his navel, who strode trinal world in three strides, effulgently blue-black like the era-ending smokily fire, cause and lord of the macrocosm and microcosm, as well...
